Who We Are

Two Massachusetts Locals
on a Mission to Do Right
By Their Neighbors.

Harold Reyes and Jose Yapul didn't start SunGrow Energy Home Services to build a business. They started it because they were tired of watching Massachusetts homeowners get taken advantage of.

With over a decade of combined experience in the home energy industry, they saw the same story play out too many times — vague contracts, inflated prices, missed promises, and zero follow-through. Hardworking families were left confused, overcharged, and underserved.

So they decided to build the company they always wished existed. One that shows up with honesty. One that puts your interests first. One that treats every homeowner like a neighbor — because in Massachusetts, that's exactly what you are.

"Our mission is simple — make sure every Massachusetts family gets properly taken care of."

FAQ

Common
Questions

Have more questions? Book your free assessment and we'll answer everything in person.

What does the home energy assessment cost?
+

Absolutely nothing. The assessment is 100% free — no hidden fees, no deposits, and zero obligation to purchase any products or services. We believe every homeowner deserves to know exactly what their home needs.

How long does the assessment take?
+

Most assessments take between 45 and 60 minutes. We work around your schedule and offer morning, afternoon, and weekend appointments. You'll receive your custom energy report on the same visit.

Do I have to buy anything after the assessment?
+

No. There is absolutely zero obligation to purchase anything after your assessment. Our advisors are energy educators, not salespeople. Many homeowners simply use the report to better understand their home — and that's completely fine with us.

What services does the assessment cover?
+

Our assessment covers all three service areas: solar potential analysis, HVAC system evaluation (heating, cooling, insulation, water heater), and roof condition inspection. You get a complete picture in one visit.

How much can I really save?
+

Our customers save an average of $5,780 per year. Solar alone can cut your electricity bill by 50–90%. Insulation and HVAC upgrades often save $500–$2,000 annually. Your assessment will include exact estimates for your specific home.

What rebates and tax credits are available?
+

The federal solar ITC covers 30% of solar costs. The Inflation Reduction Act provides up to $2,000 for heat pumps and $1,600 for insulation. Many states and utilities offer additional rebates. We identify every incentive available in your area.

How soon can I get an appointment?
+

Most homeowners get an appointment within the same week. We offer flexible morning, afternoon, and weekend slots. Submit the form and we'll reach out within one business day to confirm your time.
